## What you should be able to do tonight

- Show analytic, tree and Monte Carlo prices agreeing to a stated tolerance with convergence plotted.
- Decompose the delta-hedging profit into the variance gap and the discretisation error, with both quantified.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>65 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [30 min]{.task-min} Assemble the pricing section: the three methods across a grid of strikes and maturities, the maximum discrepancy reported, and convergence of the tree and Monte Carlo plotted against the analytic value. Include the greeks checked against finite differences.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [25 min]{.task-min} Assemble the hedging section: the profit distribution at several implied-realized gaps, the closed-form prediction overlaid, the discrete hedging error rate fitted, and the cost-optimal rebalancing frequency. One figure per claim.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [10 min]{.task-min} Write the variance risk premium page: what it is, its measured size over twenty years, and why it is not free money, with your February 2018 mechanics as the concrete answer to the last part.
